# AI Governance Literature Archive

> Static archive of 92 HTML articles on AI governance, transparency, regulation, and algorithmic accountability.

Primary resources:
- Index page: https://Ostrich121.github.io/scsrgzn/
- Metadata JSON: https://Ostrich121.github.io/scsrgzn/paper-data.json
- Full machine-readable catalog: https://Ostrich121.github.io/scsrgzn/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://Ostrich121.github.io/scsrgzn/sitemap.xml

Usage notes:
- Start from the index page or the full catalog to discover article URLs.
- Open each article HTML URL directly to read the full source text.
- The homepage cards are summaries; the article pages hold the full text.
